title: Double Jump
description: Swipe up again in the air to jump a second time.

title: Mini Cube
description: Your cube is 30% smaller, so it fits through tighter gaps.

title: Ground Pound
description: Swipe down in the air to smash the obstacle you land on.

title: High Jump
description: Your jumps go higher.

title: Long Jump
description: Your jumps carry you farther forward.

title: Glider
description: Hold your jump to glide over the road.

title: Air Brake
description: Tap the ability button to stop falling for a moment.

title: Featherweight
description: Your cube falls more slowly after a jump.

title: Wall Jump
description: Bouncing against a side wall launches you upward.

title: Wall Runner
description: Swipe into a side wall to run along it briefly.

title: Lane Blink
description: Changing lanes instantly teleports you to the next lane.

title: Wraparound
description: Swipe past the outside lane to appear on the other side.

title: Emergency Dodge
description: Once per run, your cube automatically dodges a crash into a clear lane.

title: Burrow
description: Tap the ability button to tunnel beneath the next obstacle.

title: Backstep
description: Tap the ability button to rewind your position by one second.

title: Leapfrog
description: Your cube automatically jumps over low obstacles.

title: Auto Duck
description: Your cube automatically ducks under overhead bars.

title: Bowling Cube
description: Rolling lets you knock down low obstacles.

title: Spring Legs
description: Every landing launches you into another jump until you swipe down.

title: Ceiling Runner
description: Tap the ability button to run on a temporary ceiling.

title: Grappling Hook
description: Tap the ability button to pull yourself onto the next platform.

title: Crouch Hold
description: Hold down to stay tucked beneath overhead obstacles.

title: Cannon Jump
description: Tap the ability button to launch yourself far down the road.

title: Paper Thin
description: Your cube turns sideways while changing lanes to squeeze past obstacles.

title: Express Train
description: Tap the ability button to charge straight through the next row.

title: Boomerang Jump
description: Jumping sideways brings you back to your starting lane when you land.

title: Surfboard
description: A board appears beneath you whenever you cross a gap.

title: Tightrope
description: You can run along the narrow edges between lanes.

title: Drill Roll
description: Rolling drills through tall obstacles.

title: Slide Kick
description: Rolling into an obstacle kicks it forward.

title: Shoulder Check
description: Changing lanes knocks the nearest obstacle aside.

title: Karate Chop
description: Tap the ability button to break the obstacle directly ahead.

title: Laser Beam
description: Tap the ability button to clear a straight path through your lane.

title: Sonic Clap
description: Tap the ability button to knock away the next row of obstacles.

title: Ricochet
description: Throw a ball that bounces between nearby obstacles and breaks them.

title: Freeze Ray
description: Tap the ability button to stop moving obstacles in place.

title: Fire Breath
description: Tap the ability button to burn through obstacles ahead.

title: Repulsor
description: Tap the ability button to push nearby obstacles away from you.

title: Balloon Lift
description: Attach balloons to the next obstacle so it floats out of your way.

title: Obstacle Swap
description: Tap an obstacle to move it into the neighboring lane.

title: Shrink Ray
description: Tap the ability button to make the next obstacles small enough to jump over.

title: Giant Steps
description: Tap the ability button to grow tall enough to step over obstacles.

title: Ghost Walk
description: Tap the ability button to pass through solid obstacles briefly.

title: Time Stop
description: Freeze the world while your cube keeps moving.

title: Slow Motion
description: Tap the ability button to slow the run down briefly.

title: Fast Forward
description: Tap the ability button to speed up the run briefly.

title: Reverse Gear
description: Tap the ability button to run backward for a moment.

title: Bulldozer
description: A plow pushes obstacles sideways as you run into them.

title: Dominoes
description: Breaking an obstacle sends it crashing into the next one.

title: Bowling Ball
description: Tap the ability button to roll a heavy ball down your lane.

title: Mirror Road
description: Tap the ability button to swap the left and right sides of the road.

title: Bridge Builder
description: Temporary bridges appear across gaps ahead of you.

title: Trampoline Maker
description: Tap the ability button to turn the next obstacle into a bounce pad.

title: Ramp Maker
description: Tap the ability button to turn the next wall into a ramp.

title: Middle Road
description: Tap the ability button to clear the middle lane briefly.

title: Extra Lane
description: Tap the ability button to add a temporary escape lane beside the road.

title: Shortcut Door
description: Open a door that takes you past the next obstacle row.

title: Road Flip
description: Tap the ability button to run along the underside of the road.

title: Knight Move
description: One sideways swipe can jump across two lanes.

title: Zipper
description: Open a cube-sized gap through the middle of a wall.

title: Road Lift
description: Raise your lane above the next set of obstacles.

title: Lane Slide
description: Tap the ability button to shift the whole obstacle row one lane sideways.

title: Gravity Off
description: Jump once to float until you swipe down.

title: Gravity Reverse
description: Tap the ability button to make nearby obstacles fall upward.

title: Pinball
description: Crashing into an obstacle bounces you toward the nearest clear lane.

title: Jelly Cube
description: Your cube squashes itself through low openings.

title: Liquid Cube
description: Tap the ability button to melt into a puddle beneath obstacles.

title: Scissors
description: Tap the ability button to cut overhead bars in half.

title: Shadow Clone
description: Send a copy of your cube ahead to break the next obstacle.

title: Scout Drone
description: A small drone points toward an open lane.

title: Attack Drone
description: A drone follows you and shoots obstacles ahead.

title: Pet Ram
description: Your pet ram charges ahead and knocks down the nearest wall.

title: Spider Friend
description: A pet spider webs moving obstacles in place.

title: Crane Friend
description: A little crane lifts you onto the next tall platform.

title: Digging Dog
description: Your dog digs a tunnel beneath the next wall.

title: Hungry Snake
description: A pet snake eats obstacles in the outside lanes.

title: Orbiting Hammer
description: A hammer circles your cube and breaks obstacles it touches.

title: Helping Hand
description: A tiny companion pulls you away from a crash once per run.

title: Cloud Rider
description: Tap the ability button to ride a cloud over the road briefly.

title: Decoy
description: Send out a fake cube that moving hazards chase instead.

title: Revealing Paint
description: Your trail splashes ahead to reveal hidden obstacles.

title: Headlights
description: A bright beam makes dark sections easier to see.

title: X-Ray
description: Obstacles turn transparent so you can see what is behind them.

title: Wide View
description: The camera pulls back so you can see farther ahead.

title: Warning Signs
description: Simple arrows warn you which lanes are about to become blocked.

title: Confetti Cannon
description: Blast nearby obstacles outward in a burst of confetti.

title: Dance Floor
description: Every ground pound pushes the next obstacle row one lane sideways.

title: Meteor
description: Call down a meteor to smash the obstacles ahead.

title: Rubber Road
description: The road becomes bouncy, turning every landing into a high jump.

title: Air Step
description: Tap the ability button to place a small platform beneath you in midair.
